title: 马来亚银行Erica：当局决心已明，地产阵痛五年能软着陆吗
speaker: Erica Tay

segments.en: So I think China's medium-term outlook. Has some elements of short-term pain that has to be born and that is related to the property sector
segments.zh: 我认为中国的中期展望。有一些短期阵痛必须承受，这与地产部门有关

segments.en: So we can see quite strong determination from the authorities not to bring back. This addiction to the property boom as a growth driver
segments.zh: 我们可以看到当局相当强烈的决心，不再回到。对地产繁荣作为增长驱动力的依赖

segments.en: But unfortunately, you know David that involves. Lower output and lower demand for a lot of related sectors. including. Manufacturing
segments.zh: 但不幸的是，大卫，这涉及。许多相关部门的产出下降和需求下降。包括。制造业

segments.en: Including retail sales and consumer confidence and also. Lower government land sales proceeds so we know that a lot of local governments
segments.zh: 包括零售销售和消费者信心，还有。政府土地出让收入下降，我们知道很多地方政府

segments.en: They depend on land sales for much of their revenues. In the past several years and that has gone down by more than 80 percent
segments.zh: 他们的大部分收入依赖土地出让。在过去几年中，这一收入下降了超过80%

segments.en: So I think the government has in the interim of trying to manage the weakness of this. slow moving contraction
segments.zh: 所以我认为政府在此期间试图管理这种。缓慢收缩的疲软

segments.en: Of the property sector to try and make sure that things. Don't fall off the cliff and we can see from today's home sales numbers that
segments.zh: 地产部门的收缩，试图确保事情。不会跌落悬崖，我们可以从今天的住宅成交数据看到

segments.en: Their efforts at engineering a gentle shrinkage. Are starting to pay off and then we look at the non-property
segments.zh: 他们引导温和收缩的努力。开始见效，然后我们看非地产

segments.en: Sactors in the medium term. I think it cannot just be about supporting tech and innovation
segments.zh: 中期内的部门。我认为不能只是支持科技和创新

segments.en: Some support should go towards the third cluster of the economy those that are generating jobs so that
segments.zh: 一些支持应该流向经济的第三集群，那些创造就业的部门，以便

segments.en: Some attention towards. Propping up those
segments.zh: 一些关注投向。支撑那些

segments.en: Sactors including in the services sector that will be quite helpful in trying to manage the economy in the next five years
segments.zh: 部门，包括服务业，这将非常有助于在未来五年管理经济
